name: vscode-lm-openai-gateway
description: Local OpenAI-compatible API (/v1/models, /v1/chat/completions) on 127.0.0.1, backed by the VS Code Language Model API (vscode.lm).

commands.title: Copilot LM Gateway: Test (grant model access)

copilotGateway.port.description: Port on 127.0.0.1 for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

copilotGateway.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort sent with every request (e.g. low, medium, high, xhigh). Empty uses the model picker setting.
